answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 5853 Country: India Title: Is working as a advocate is jayaz in islam or not? Question: Is working as a advocate is jayaz in islam or not? Answer ID: 5853 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 409/409=M/1429) If an advocate follows up right cases and avoids telling lie then it is allowed for him to work as advocate. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
